description:
[read-only] The brand's ads problems from its ad networks, most severe first: payment problems, rejected ads, lost connections, delivery issues, capped budgets, spend with no results. Each row has one action: `fix` (the ad network's own fix page, give the user the link), `reconnect`, `raise_cap`, `pause` or `view` (flayr pages). To pause a campaign use ads_campaign_pause; to change caps use the spend tools. `limit` 1-50, `includeDismissed` to see hidden rows. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/attention.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key is pinned to its brand and any other value is 403.

limit.description: Rows to return; defaults to the configured attention row cap.

name: ads_attention_list
title: What needs attention in ads
